For server admins and those with cheat mode enabled, Blood Magic has some useful commands (note the command root is /bloodmagic on this branch):
- /bloodmagic soul-network <player> add <amount> adds the given amount of LP to that player's Soul Network.
- /bloodmagic soul-network <player> query lists their current total (akin to using a Divination Sigil bound to them).

- /bloodmagic soul-network <player> reset empties their Soul Network.
- /bloodmagic soul-network <player> set <amount> sets the total LP in their Soul Network to the given amount.
There's also a /bloodmagic living-upgrade command for directly setting Living Armour upgrade levels and limits - handy for testing and admin purposes.
